description:
Speak, don't type

Speak naturally, and Typeless will turn your words into polished messages, emails, and documents that read like you carefully typed them - in real time. 4x faster than typing.
Custom shortcuts for mouse buttons

You can now add side buttons or middle click on your mouse as shortcuts for Dictate, Translate, and Ask anything.
Mouse shortcuts let speaking follow naturally from your mouse actions: click into a reply or document and speak what you want to add, or scroll through information and ask a question.
- Add mouse shortcuts: Go to Settings, click "Add another" under Shortcuts, then press the mouse button you want to use. Repeat to add more shortcuts.
We hope Typeless fits more naturally into the way you already work on desktop.
